document.body:
================================================================================
RPG SNAP & SCORE AI -> NEURALMESH KNOWLEDGE GRAPH SEED DATA SPECIFICATION
================================================================================
Generated: 2026-11-13
Version: 1.0.0
Audience: NeuralMesh Engineering Team (Knowledge Graph & Graph RAG Modelers)

OVERVIEW:
This archive contains the definitive structural seed datasets exported from the 
RPG Snap & Score AI project. These files define the multi-tier asset hierarchy,
defect conditions, quality standard clauses, remaining useful life (RUL) 
prognostic models, and insurance policies across 4 RPG Group subsidiaries:
  1. CEAT Limited (Tyres & Automotive Rubber)
  2. Harrisons Malayalam Limited (Natural Rubber & Estate Crops)
  3. KEC International Limited (Power Transmission & Rail Infrastructure)
  4. Raychem RPG Limited (HV Cable Accessories & Jointing)

FILES INCLUDED IN THIS EXPORT:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. asset_taxonomy.json
   - Hierarchical breakdown: Subsidiary -> Asset Family -> Asset -> Inspection Views.
   - Scan mechanisms (Barcode, QR, Lot Tag, Tower Member ID, Joint ID).
   - Governing plant grading scales (tyre_plant, tyre_fleet, sheet_visual, qa_basic, patrol_priority).

2. defect_ontology.json
   - Visual conditions and failure symptoms.
   - Severity tiers (Critical, High, Moderate, Cosmetic).
   - Physical failure modes (Carcass blowout, Fungal biodegradation, Tower buckling, Flashover).
   - Visual cue signatures (geometry, texture, HSV color space boundaries).

3. sop_standards.json
   - Plant Quality Operating Standards and specific standard clauses.
   - Governing specifications: ISO 10191, ASTM F538, IRSG Green Book, IS 802, ISO 12944, IEEE 404, IEC 60502.
   - Exact numerical acceptance thresholds and mandatory quarantine actions.
   - Direct feed for Snap & Score Level 9 NeuralMesh SOP Terminal.

4. rul_prognostics.json
   - Physics-grounded Remaining Useful Life (RUL) degradation models.
   - Baseline design units:
       * CEAT Tyres: 60,000 km / 48 Months
       * Harrisons Malayalam: 24.0 Months (Warehouse Storage)
       * KEC International: 40.0 Years (Atmospheric Service Life)
       * Raychem RPG: 30.0 Years (Dielectric Insulation Horizon)
   - Wear index equations and maintenance intervention triggers.

5. insurance_policies.json
   - Policy reference bindings (POL-RPG-CEAT-09, POL-RPG-HARRISONS-09, etc.).
   - Underwriting perils covered.
   - Step-by-step claim settlement workflows for automated dossier dispatch.

GRAPH SCHEMA MAPPING RECOMMENDATION (Neo4j / RDF / TigerGraph):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nodes:
  (:Subsidiary {id, name, sector})
  (:AssetFamily {id, name})
  (:Asset {id, name, scan_type, grade_scale, baseline_lifespan})
  (:View {name})
  (:Defect {id, family, severity, primary_failure_mode})
  (:StandardClause {clause_ref, standard_id, acceptance_limit, remedial_action})
  (:RULModel {baseline_units, unit, lifespan_category, physics})
  (:Policy {policy_ref, cover_type, underwriter})

Relationships:
  (:Subsidiary)-[:OPERATES_FAMILY]->(:AssetFamily)
  (:AssetFamily)-[:CONTAINS_ASSET]->(:Asset)
  (:Asset)-[:INSPECTED_VIA]->(:View)
  (:Asset)-[:SUBJECT_TO_DEFECT]->(:Defect)
  (:Defect)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(:StandardClause)
  (:Asset)-[:PROGNOSTIC_CURVE]->(:RULModel)
  (:Asset)-[:INSURED_UNDER]->(:Policy)

RUNTIME REST ENDPOINTS EXPECTED BY SNAP & SCORE (rest_client.py):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. GET /assets/{asset_id}
   -> Returns AssetRecord (name, subsidiary, family, scan_type, site, batch)
2. GET /assets/{asset_id}/inspection_profile
   -> Returns InspectionProfile (views, conditions, grade_scale, thresholds)
3. GET /assets/{asset_id}/cover
   -> Returns CoverInfo (policy_ref, cover_type, insured, claim_steps)
4. GET /standards/search?asset_id={...}&condition_id={...}
   -> Returns StandardResult (standard_id, title, acceptance_clause, next_check)
5. POST /experts/ask
   -> Body: {question, asset_id, context_image_ref} -> Returns ExpertAnswer
6. POST /cases/similar
   -> Body: {asset_id, conditions, limit} -> Returns list of SimilarCase
7. POST /claims/build
   -> Body: {asset_id, inspection_id, evidence_refs} -> Returns ClaimPack
================================================================================
